verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a dedicated bug-fix workflow ("Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix" and incident-watching that gathers logs/changes and routes issues) plus general autonomous coding-agent capabilities (CLI/task execution, auto-approve actions, any-LLM backend) that support diagnosing and fixing bugs end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of actual bug-fix success rate and no third-party benchmark evidence corroborating the vendor docs.
